items.en: 1. Introduction
items.zh: 1. 引言

items.en: Public housing is often discussed as if its quality were a plain fact, yet the way it is understood changes with the plans made for it. Zanardo et al. (2024, 1207) open their study of the Waterloo estate in Sydney with a claim: "The history of public housing in Australia is being rewritten by redevelopment." In a district planned as part of a global city, the imagined future of a place and the planning treatment given to it are closely tied, because a plan needs a past to replace and a future to deliver.
items.zh: 公共住房的质量常被当作一个明摆着的事实来谈，但人们怎样理解它，其实随着为它制定的规划而变。Zanardo et al. (2024, 1207) 在研究悉尼 Waterloo 住宅区时开篇就提出一个论断：“澳大利亚公共住房的历史正在被更新项目改写。”在一个被规划为全球城市一部分的地区，一个地方被想象出来的未来，和施加在它身上的规划处理紧紧相连，因为一份规划既需要一个要被取代的过去，也需要一个要被交付的未来。
items.summary: 开场：Zanardo 等的第一句，说公共住房的理解随规划而变。

items.en: Waterloo, with about 2,000 dwellings on 18 hectares, is among Sydney's largest inner-city public housing estates (Chatterjee et al. 2018), and its renewal has been described as the largest estate renewal proposed in Australia to date (Zanardo et al. 2024, 1208). The plan has changed several times since the state government announced it in 2015. The planning route moved from a state-led process to a council-led one in 2019 (Turner Studio & Turf 2020, PDF p. 6) and back to the state in 2021 (NSW Department of Planning and Environment 2022, PDF p. 11), and in 2023 the target for social and affordable housing across the estate was raised from 34 to 50 per cent (NSW Government 2023).
items.zh: Waterloo 约有 2,000 套住宅、占地 18 公顷，是悉尼最大的市区公共住宅区之一（Chatterjee et al. 2018），它的更新被描述为澳大利亚迄今提出的最大的住宅区更新计划（Zanardo et al. 2024, 1208）。自 2015 年州政府宣布以来，这份计划已经变动了好几次：规划路径在 2019 年从州主导改为市议会主导（Turner Studio & Turf 2020, PDF p. 6），2021 年又回到州政府手里（NSW Department of Planning and Environment 2022, PDF p. 11），2023 年全区社会住房与可负担住房的目标从 34% 提高到 50%（NSW Government 2023）。
items.summary: 案例事实：Waterloo 的规模，以及 2015 年以来规划路径和目标的变化。

items.en: Its reputation has also kept changing, and it has been contested between the government and its residents. Zanardo et al. (2024, 1208–1209) record officials calling the estate "terrible" (Hazzard), "not fit for purpose" (Jackson) and "well past the renewal date" (Hoenig). The housing minister, Rose Jackson, has since said that "old style estates with thousands and thousands of public homes in the one place" are "not functional communities" (Bowring 2026), a remark about that kind of estate and not about Waterloo alone. Residents speak differently. Julie, a resident, said, "Waterloo is my home, I want to stay here," and the housing activist Karyn Brown, answering the minister, said, "It is very functional" (Bowring 2026).
items.zh: 它的声誉也一直在变，并且在政府和居民之间被争夺。Zanardo et al. (2024, 1208–1209) 记录了官员把这片住宅区称为“糟糕透顶”（Hazzard）、“不适合其用途”（Jackson）和“早就该更新了”（Hoenig）。住房部长 Rose Jackson 后来说，“成千上万套公屋集中在一个地方的老式住宅区”是“不具功能的社区”（Bowring 2026），这句话说的是那一类住宅区，不只是 Waterloo。居民的说法不一样。居民 Julie 说：“Waterloo 是我的家，我想留在这里”；住房活动者 Karyn Brown 回应部长时说：“它非常有功能”（Bowring 2026）。
items.summary: 声誉的争夺：官员的说法与居民的说法；Jackson 那句说的是一类住宅区。

items.en: Zanardo et al. (2024, 1236) and Sisson (2024) describe this pattern as a reputational gap, a term Yrjänä (2026) attributes to Kallin: the present of a place is devalued and its imagined potential is set against it, which makes intervention easier to justify. Wynne and Rogers (2021) show how residents experience the threat of displacement before any demolition.
items.zh: Zanardo et al. (2024, 1236) 和 Sisson (2024) 把这种模式描述为声誉差距(reputational gap)，Yrjänä (2026) 把这个词归到 Kallin 名下：一个地方的现在被贬低，它被想象出来的潜力被拿来与之对照，这让干预更容易得到辩护。Wynne and Rogers (2021) 则展示了居民在任何拆除发生之前，是怎样经历被迫搬迁的威胁的。
items.summary: 已有研究：声誉差距（Zanardo 等、Sisson、Yrjänä）和在地失所（Wynne and Rogers）。

items.en: Sydney's council describes the market in which this renewal takes place: "Gentrification of inner city neighbourhoods has exacerbated relative inequality among those who can and cannot afford housing," and there is "a growing disconnect between affluent households able to afford private market housing and highly socio-economically disadvantaged households living in inner city public housing estates" (City of Sydney n.d.). The official case for renewing such estates answers a version of the same divide. Future Directions describes disadvantage that clusters in estates and is "passed on through multiple generations" (NSW Government 2016, 24), and mixed tenure is its remedy. This paper asks whether the renewal of Waterloo breaks that circle or relocates it. It reads the plan's tenure mix, the destinations of relocated tenants and the promise of return against the five steps of the vicious circle of segregation (Rosengren 2026; Tammaru et al. 2021), in a city where the median price of attached dwellings more than doubled between 2006 and 2026 (Australian Bureau of Statistics 2026). The sections follow the four units of the course: the global city, housing, segregation and gentrification.
items.zh: 悉尼市议会这样描述这次更新所处的市场：“市区社区的绅士化加剧了能负担和不能负担住房的人之间的相对不平等”，并且“能负担私人市场住房的富裕家庭，与住在市区公共住宅区、社会经济上高度弱势的家庭之间，脱节越来越大”（City of Sydney n.d.）。官方更新这类住宅区的理由，回应的正是同一种分裂的一个版本：Future Directions 把弱势描述为在住宅区里聚集，并“代代相传”（NSW Government 2016, 24），混合租住(mixed tenure)是它的药方。本文要问的是，Waterloo 的更新是打破了这个循环，还是把它搬到了别处。它把计划的租住混合、被搬迁租户的去向和回迁的承诺，对照隔离恶性循环(vicious circle of segregation)的五个步骤（Rosengren 2026；Tammaru et al. 2021）来读，背景是一座城市，其中附属住宅(attached dwellings)的中位价格在 2006 到 2026 年间翻了一倍多（Australian Bureau of Statistics 2026）。各节按课程的四个单元展开：全球城市、住房、隔离和绅士化。
items.summary: 中心问题：City of Sydney 对市场的描述，官方的隔离诊断，本文问药方是打破循环还是搬走它，以及课程四单元的路线。

items.en: 2. The global city: why Waterloo is drawn into the dispute
items.zh: 2. 全球城市：为什么 Waterloo 被卷进这场纠纷

items.en: The introductory unit of the course places Sydney’s housing in the frame of the global city, a city whose competitiveness rests on central land, infrastructure and the services of a global economy (Sassen 1991). The state’s metropolitan strategy of 2014 follows this logic. It defines a Global Economic Corridor that “generates over 41 per cent of the NSW Gross State Product” and names Green Square among its strategic centres, while the text of the strategy does not name Waterloo (NSW Planning and Environment 2014, 44). The unit also treats urban space as a terrain on which claims on land are contested, and Wynne (2018) shows what this means for tenants in Waterloo, who live inside a policy of global-city ambition that reaches their homes. I read land as the place where the ambition of the city meets the people who already live on it. This applies the unit’s concepts to Sydney, which the lectures do not do.
items.zh: 课程的导论单元把悉尼的住房放进全球城市(global city)的框架里：这样的城市，竞争力建立在中心区的土地、基础设施和全球经济所需的服务之上（Sassen 1991）。州政府 2014 年的大都市战略遵循的正是这种逻辑。它界定了一条全球经济走廊，“贡献了 NSW 州内生产总值的 41% 以上”，并把 Green Square 列为战略中心，而战略文本里没有点名 Waterloo（NSW Planning and Environment 2014, 44）。这个单元还把城市空间看作各方对土地的主张相互争夺的场域(terrain)，Wynne (2018) 展示了这对 Waterloo 的租户意味着什么：他们生活在一套全球城市雄心的政策里，而这套政策触及了他们的家。我把土地读作城市的雄心与已经住在上面的人相遇的地方。这是把单元里的概念应用到悉尼，讲义并没有这样做。
items.summary: ¶2.1　课件：导论单元。概念：Sassen 的全球城市；斗争场域（讲义里 Brenner & Schmid 的说法）。展开：用 2014 年规划把概念落到悉尼，说明为什么这片土地被需要；最后一句标明“土地成为雄心与居民相遇的地方”是应用，不是讲义的话。证据：规划文本、Wynne (2018)。

items.en: Prices give this ambition its weight. The median transfer price of attached dwellings in Sydney, the market in which flats such as Waterloo’s sit, rose from $390,000 in June 2006 to $840,000 in June 2026, and that of houses from $495,000 to $1,487,600 (Australian Bureau of Statistics 2026). The rise has paused. Cotality’s index shows Sydney values down 9.4 per cent over the year to October 2026, although they remain 34.5 per cent higher than ten years earlier (Cotality 2026). New tenants in postcode 2017, which includes Waterloo, paid a median of $1,050 a week in the June 2026 quarter, against $780 for Greater Sydney (NSW Department of Communities and Justice 2026). The picture is not uniform. Census median rents in Waterloo were $520 in 2016 and $530 in 2021, and in Zetland they fell from $650 to $600, although the two censuses are not strictly comparable (Australian Bureau of Statistics 2016a, 2016b, 2021a, 2021b).
items.zh: 价格给这种雄心带来了分量。悉尼附属住宅的中位转手价格，也就是 Waterloo 这类公寓所在的市场，从 2006 年 6 月的 39 万澳元涨到 2026 年 6 月的 84 万澳元，独立屋则从 49.5 万涨到 148.76 万澳元（Australian Bureau of Statistics 2026）。涨势已经停住。Cotality 的指数显示，到 2026 年 10 月为止的一年里悉尼房价下降了 9.4%，不过仍比十年前高 34.5%（Cotality 2026）。2026 年 6 月季度，邮编 2017（包含 Waterloo）的新租户每周租金中位数为 1,050 澳元，大悉尼为 780 澳元（NSW Department of Communities and Justice 2026）。图景并不一致：Waterloo 的普查中位租金 2016 年是 520 澳元，2021 年是 530 澳元，Zetland 则从 650 降到 600 澳元，不过两次普查并不完全可比（Australian Bureau of Statistics 2016a, 2016b, 2021a, 2021b）。
items.summary: ¶2.2　课件：导论单元，也为绅士化单元的租金差做铺垫。展开：用价格数据说明土地为什么值钱；同时写出 2026 年回调和 2016–2021 年的反例，不写成“现在还在涨”。注意：邮编 2017 对应 Waterloo 是常识，文件没有写明，需核对。证据：ABS、Cotality、DCJ、普查。

items.en: Figure 1. Sydney’s median transfer prices have risen strongly since 2006, though they fell in 2026 (see text).
items.zh: 图 1. 悉尼的中位转手价格自 2006 年以来大幅上涨，但在 2026 年回落（见正文）。数据来自 ABS 的原表，单位为千澳元，名义价格。

items.en: Within this setting the metro station became the trigger for change. The urban design study for Waterloo South calls it “the catalyst for the renewal” (Turner Studio & Turf 2020, Part 1, PDF p. 6), and the planning proposal argues that keeping the site as it is would ignore “the potential catalytic effects of the new Metro station” (NSW Land and Housing Corporation [LAHC] 2020, 92). The estate itself is read through a diagnosis that the state applies to estates in general. Future Directions finds that “many estates experience high levels of crime, unemployment, domestic violence, tenancy management problems, poor educational outcomes and associated child protection issues” (NSW Government 2016, PDF p. 24). The frame explains why the land is wanted. The diagnosis, taken up in section 4, explains why the housing on it is thought to need replacing.
items.zh: 在这样的背景下，地铁站成了变化的触发点。Waterloo South 的城市设计研究称它为“这次更新的催化剂”（Turner Studio & Turf 2020, Part 1, PDF p. 6），规划建议书则论证说，保持现状会忽视新地铁站“潜在的催化效应”（NSW Land and Housing Corporation [LAHC] 2020, 92）。这片住宅区本身，是通过州政府对住宅区的一般性诊断来被解读的。Future Directions 认为，“许多住宅区存在高水平的犯罪、失业、家庭暴力、租赁管理问题、较差的教育结果和相关的儿童保护问题”（NSW Government 2016, PDF p. 24）。这个框架解释了为什么要这块土地，第 4 节要处理的诊断则解释了为什么上面的住房被认为需要替换。
items.summary: ¶2.3　课件：导论单元收尾，转向隔离单元。展开：地铁站是触发点；官方对住宅区的诊断是后面第 4 节要检验的对象。证据：规划建议书、城市设计研究、Future Directions（全州文件，不是 Waterloo 专属）。

items.en: 3. Housing: the strategy, and the conflict between home and real estate
items.zh: 3. 住房：策略，以及家与房地产的矛盾

items.en: The housing unit asks what housing is for. Its central contrast is between housing as a lived, social space and housing as an instrument of profit, a conflict between home and real estate (Madden and Marcuse 2016). The strategy for Waterloo shows both sides. In December 2015 the state announced that the estate would be demolished and rebuilt with about 30 per cent social and 70 per cent private housing, the sale of the private dwellings funding the project (Zanardo et al. 2024, 1208), in line with a statewide target of 70:30 (NSW Government 2016, PDF p. 9). The Premier said that no one would want tenants “sitting in run down 1950s-style accommodation” (Gerathy 2015). In November 2019 the planning route changed from a state-led process to a council-led one (Turner Studio & Turf 2020, Part 1, PDF p. 6), and in March 2021 the state took the role of planning authority from the council (NSW Department of Planning and Environment 2022, PDF p. 11). The planning proposal describes the existing properties as “at the end of their economic life” (LAHC 2020, 23), while the same study gives their average age as 44 years against a benchmark life of 60 (Turner Studio & Turf 2020, Part 1, PDF p. 6).
items.zh: 住房单元问的是：住房是为了什么。它的核心对比，是住房作为生活的、社会性的空间，与住房作为盈利工具之间的冲突，也就是家与房地产(home and real estate)的冲突（Madden and Marcuse 2016）。Waterloo 的策略把两边都展示了出来。2015 年 12 月，州政府宣布这片住宅区将被拆除重建，约 30% 社会住房、70% 私人住房，出售私人住宅来为项目筹资（Zanardo et al. 2024, 1208），这与全州 70:30 的目标一致（NSW Government 2016, PDF p. 9）。州长说，没有人愿意租户“住在破旧的 1950 年代式住房里”（Gerathy 2015）。2019 年 11 月，规划路径从州主导改为市议会主导（Turner Studio & Turf 2020, Part 1, PDF p. 6），2021 年 3 月，州政府从市议会手里接过了规划主管机关的角色（NSW Department of Planning and Environment 2022, PDF p. 11）。规划建议书把现有房产描述为“处于经济寿命的终点”（LAHC 2020, 23），而同一项研究给出的平均房龄是 44 年，基准寿命是 60 年（Turner Studio & Turf 2020, Part 1, PDF p. 6）。
items.summary: ¶3.1　课件：住房单元。概念：Madden & Marcuse 的家与房地产。展开：先给出讲义的对立，再按时间写 2015–2021 年策略怎样变，并列出官方对房子的描述（Baird、经济寿命）。注意“44 年对 60 年”并排出现，文件没有解释。证据：Zanardo 等、Future Directions、规划文件。

items.en: The terms then changed. The plan approved in 2022 provides 3,012 dwellings, of which 847 are social housing (NSW Department of Planning and Environment 2022, PDF p. 37). After a change of government in March 2023, the share of social and affordable housing across the estate was raised from 34 to 50 per cent, tenants were promised the right to return, and relocation was to proceed in small stages (NSW Government 2023). In 2024 the government promised at least six months’ notice and dedicated support, and repeated that all residents would be given the right to return (NSW Government 2024). By 2026 a new concept application proposed about 3,300 homes, at least half of them social or affordable (Scully 2026), and fencing began around the first block of about 150 homes, due for demolition by the end of June (Bowring 2026). Seventy social homes at the Waterloo Metro Quarter have been occupied (NSW Government 2025). Descriptions of the estate did not soften with the change of government. Brad Hazzard, a minister under the former government, called it “terrible”, and Rose Jackson, a minister under the present one, “not fit for purpose” (Zanardo et al. 2024, 1208–1209).
items.zh: 随后条件变了。2022 年批准的计划提供 3,012 套住宅，其中 847 套是社会住房（NSW Department of Planning and Environment 2022, PDF p. 37）。2023 年 3 月政府更替之后，全区社会与可负担住房的比例从 34% 提高到 50%，租户获得回迁权的承诺，搬迁将分小批进行（NSW Government 2023）。2024 年，政府承诺至少提前六个月通知并提供专门支持，并重申所有居民都将获得回迁权（NSW Government 2024）。到 2026 年，新的概念申请提出约 3,300 套住宅，其中至少一半是社会住房或可负担住房（Scully 2026），首批约 150 套住宅的围栏开始搭建，预定在 6 月底前拆除（Bowring 2026）。Waterloo Metro Quarter 的 70 套社会住房已有人入住（NSW Government 2025）。对这片住宅区的描述并没有随着政府更替而变软。前一届政府的部长 Brad Hazzard 称它“糟糕透顶”，现任政府的部长 Rose Jackson 称它“不适合其用途”（Zanardo et al. 2024, 1208–1209）。
items.summary: ¶3.2　课件：住房单元（政策与策略的变化）。展开：2022–2026 年条件在变（比例、回迁、通知），而对住宅区的负面描述跨两届政府连续。证据：规划部报告、新闻稿、Zanardo 等转引。这里显示的是承诺和提案，不是结果。

items.en: Read through the unit, the strategy places the estate between the two sides. On the side of real estate, the planning proposal states that the existing controls “would not be capable of supporting a feasible redevelopment of the entire site given the costs of demolition and construction” (LAHC 2020, 92), an early proposal offered extra floor space only if 30 per cent of residential floor area were social housing and 20 per cent affordable (NSW Land and Housing Corporation 2021, Attachment A), and the sale of private dwellings carries the cost. On the side of home, there are the right to return, more social homes in Waterloo South than there are now (Homes NSW 2026), and at least 15 per cent of new social and affordable homes for Aboriginal people (NSW Government 2023). No official document sets out the funding model in these terms. The reading is an application of the unit’s contrast.
items.zh: 用这个单元来读，这套策略把这片住宅区放在了两边之间。在房地产一侧，规划建议书说，现有管制“考虑到拆除和建设的成本，不足以支持对整个场地进行可行的重新开发”（LAHC 2020, 92），一份早期提案只有在 30% 的住宅楼面面积用作社会住房、20% 用作可负担住房时，才提供额外的楼面面积（NSW Land and Housing Corporation 2021, Attachment A），出售私人住宅则负担了成本。在家的一侧，有回迁权，Waterloo South 的社会住房比现在多（Homes NSW 2026），以及新建社会与可负担住房中至少 15% 留给原住民（NSW Government 2023）。没有哪份官方文件用这样的话来说明资金模式。这种读法是对单元里那组对比的应用。

items.en: 4. Segregation: testing the remedy against the chain
items.zh: 4. 隔离：用链条检验药方

items.en: The segregation unit gives the course’s account of how segregation reproduces itself. Tammaru et al. (2021) describe vicious circles of segregation as the product of the connectedness of social and spatial inequalities in different life domains: advantage breeds advantage and disadvantage breeds disadvantage. The lecture sets out five steps. Disadvantage clusters spatially, neighbourhood effects follow, poor perceptions shape who moves, segregation spreads to other domains such as schools and work, and it becomes immobility across the life course and across generations (Rosengren 2026). The state’s case for renewal follows the same chain. Future Directions finds disadvantage concentrated in estates, says that its effects “can be passed on through multiple generations, reinforcing the cycle of disadvantage” (NSW Government 2016, PDF p. 24), and proposes a ratio of 70:30 of private to social housing “to enable more integrated communities” (NSW Government 2016, PDF p. 9).
items.zh: 隔离单元给出了课程对隔离如何自我再生产的说明。Tammaru et al. (2021) 把隔离的恶性循环(vicious circles of segregation)描述为不同生活领域里社会不平等与空间不平等相互关联的产物：优势滋生优势，弱势滋生弱势。讲义列出了五个步骤：弱势在空间上聚集，邻里效应(neighbourhood effects)随之而来，不佳的观感影响谁会搬迁，隔离扩展到学校、工作等其他领域，最终成为贯穿整个生命历程、跨越代际的不能流动(immobility)（Rosengren 2026）。州政府更新住宅区的理由遵循的是同一条链。Future Directions 认为弱势集中在住宅区，说其影响“可以代代相传，强化弱势的循环”（NSW Government 2016, PDF p. 24），并提出私人住房与社会住房 70:30 的比例，“以形成更融合的社区”（NSW Government 2016, PDF p. 9）。
items.summary: ¶4.1　课件：隔离单元。概念：Tammaru 等的恶性循环；Rosengren 的五步链。展开：先写讲义里的链，再指出官方的更新理由就是这条链，药方是混合租住。这是全文的中心，后面四段按步骤检验。

items.en: The renewal acts most clearly on the first step. Waterloo South now has 749 social and 120 private dwellings, about 86 per cent social housing, and the approved plan has 847 social dwellings among 3,012, about 28 per cent (NSW Department of Planning and Environment 2022, PDF pp. 8, 37; shares calculated from these figures). This is the dilution by social mixing that the lecture names as the way residential segregation becomes less visible. The precedent that the urban design study uses for density says less about mix. Green Square Town Centre is tabulated with 104 social and affordable dwellings among 3,308, about 3 per cent, and Waterloo and Zetland together are shown rising from 143 to 247 people per hectare (Turner Studio & Turf 2020, App. 6, 463–464). The comparison is limited, because the town centre is one part of Green Square and the City’s own target is 7.5 per cent social and 7.5 per cent affordable rental housing across its area (City of Sydney n.d.).
items.zh: 更新作用得最明显的是第一步。Waterloo South 现有 749 套社会住房和 120 套私人住房，社会住房约占 86%；获批的计划在 3,012 套中有 847 套社会住房，约 28%（NSW Department of Planning and Environment 2022, PDF pp. 8, 37；占比由这些数字计算）。这就是讲义所说的、让居住隔离变得不那么显眼的社会混合的稀释。城市设计研究用来说明密度的先例，在混合上说得更少。Green Square Town Centre 的表格显示 3,308 套住宅中有 104 套社会与可负担住房，约 3%，Waterloo 与 Zetland 合在一起的人口密度从每公顷 143 人升到 247 人（Turner Studio & Turf 2020, App. 6, 463–464）。这种比较有局限，因为这个镇中心只是 Green Square 的一部分，而市议会自己的目标是在其辖区内达到 7.5% 的社会住房和 7.5% 的可负担租赁住房（City of Sydney n.d.）。

items.en: Figure 4. The share of social housing at Waterloo South falls from about 86 to about 28 per cent in the plan; Green Square Town Centre is shown for comparison.
items.zh: 图 4. 计划里 Waterloo South 的社会住房占比从约 86% 降到约 28%；Green Square Town Centre 作为对照。占比由原文数字计算；Green Square 的数字口径是社会加可负担，只是一个镇中心。

items.en: Where displaced households go decides whether a cluster is dissolved or moved. Current tenants have been relocated to other public housing, including at least 70 into the new homes beside the Waterloo metro station (Bowring 2026). The government names two local destinations, the 70 social homes at the Metro Quarter and about 95 more at Elizabeth Street, Redfern (Homes NSW 2026), and in 2023 it presented Elizabeth Street as a way for Waterloo South tenants to be relocated in the local area (NSW Government 2023). In the chain’s terms, these place social housing together in separate buildings nearby. The documents do not give the number of tenants at each destination. What can be said is that the first step is diluted on one site while social housing is placed on others.
items.zh: 被搬迁的家庭去哪里，决定了一个聚集是被打散了，还是被搬走了。现有租户已被安置到其他公共住房，其中至少 70 人搬进了 Waterloo 地铁站旁的新房（Bowring 2026）。政府点出了两个本区的去向：Metro Quarter 的 70 套社会住房，以及 Redfern 的 Elizabeth Street 约 95 套（Homes NSW 2026），2023 年它还把 Elizabeth Street 说成是让 Waterloo South 租户在本区安置的一种方式（NSW Government 2023）。按链条的说法，这等于把社会住房集中放在了附近的另外几栋楼里。文件没有给出各去向的租户人数。可以说的是，第一步在一个场地上被稀释了，而社会住房被放到了其他场地上。
items.summary: ¶4.3　课件：隔离单元第 1 步和第 3 步（谁移动、移到哪里）。展开：被搬走的人去了其他社会住房，是把聚集搬了地方的证据。限定：只有去向的名称，没有各去向的人数，所以只能写“可以说的是……”。

items.en: The later steps rest on evidence that is less settled. Sisson (2024) notes that the concept of neighbourhood effects behind “concentrated disadvantage” “controversially” places the cause in the estate, and Zanardo et al. (2024) conclude that most of the existing buildings, with the possible exception of the slab blocks, could have their lives extended with relatively modest renovation. Tenure mix changes who lives where. It does not by itself change services, schooling or employment, which steps four and five concern. Meanwhile uncertainty already acts on steps three and five. Wynne and Rogers (2021) argue that the threat of eviction “has already done significant damage to their relationship to place” before any move. A resident, Julie, said that she heard of the demolition work when she woke to find fences going up, and that her relocation had been delayed, and another, Karyn Brown, said of the estate, “It is very functional” (Bowring 2026). The planning minister’s release says that the renewal “stalled for years” (Scully 2026). Read through the chain, residents neither choose nor time their mobility, and the wait is part of the circle. This is a reading. The documents do not measure residents’ mobility or opportunities.
items.zh: 后面几步依靠的证据没那么确定。Sisson (2024) 指出，“集中的弱势”背后的邻里效应概念“有争议地”把原因放在住宅区上；Zanardo et al. (2024) 则认为，除板楼可能是例外外，大多数现有建筑只需相对适度的翻新就能延长寿命。租住混合改变的是谁住在哪里，它本身并不改变服务、学校或就业，而第四、第五步关心的正是这些。与此同时，不确定性已经在作用于第三和第五步。Wynne and Rogers (2021) 认为，在任何搬迁发生之前，被驱逐的威胁就已经“对他们与地方的关系造成了重大伤害”。居民 Julie 说，她是醒来看到围栏在搭才知道要拆除，而她的搬迁被推迟了；另一位居民 Karyn Brown 说，这片住宅区“非常有功能”（Bowring 2026）。规划部长的新闻稿说这次更新“停滞了好几年”（Scully 2026）。用链条来读，居民既不能选择也无法决定自己何时流动，等待本身就是循环的一部分。这是一种读法，文件并没有测量居民的流动或机会。
items.summary: ¶4.4　课件：隔离单元第 2–5 步；并连到在地失所（Wynne & Rogers）。展开：邻里效应有争议（Sisson）、建筑质量不一（Zanardo），混合租住处理不到服务、学校、就业；不确定性作用于第 3、5 步。限定：这是读法，没有测量。

items.en: 5. Gentrification: price, cost and promise
items.zh: 5. 绅士化：价格、代价与承诺

items.en: The gentrification unit asks who gains when land is reinvested in and who bears the cost. Smith’s rent gap is the disparity between potential ground rent and the rent capitalised under the present use (Smith 1979), and Stein describes gentrification as “planned by the state, produced by the developers and consumed by the condo crowd” (Stein 2019, 41). Zanardo et al. (2024) connect Waterloo to a gap between the ground rents realised by the state and those potentially received through partial privatisation and redevelopment, and Sisson (2024) shows that the Communities Plus program selects high-value sites so that the state can obtain “value for money”. Sydney’s council states that gentrification “has exacerbated relative inequality among those who can and cannot afford housing” and that the market is becoming “virtually inaccessible to those on very low to moderate incomes” (City of Sydney n.d.). For Sydney and Melbourne, Atkinson et al. (2011, 10) found that the displacement rate from gentrified neighbourhoods was around 50 per cent higher than the out-movement rate for equivalent households elsewhere, although their data come from the 2000s.
items.zh: 绅士化单元问的是：土地被重新投资时，谁获益，谁承担代价。Smith 的租金差(rent gap)是潜在地租与现有用途下被资本化的地租之间的差距（Smith 1979），Stein 则把绅士化描述为“由国家规划、由开发商生产、由公寓族消费”（Stein 2019, 41）。Zanardo et al. (2024) 把 Waterloo 与这样一个差距联系起来：国家实现的地租，与通过部分私有化和重新开发可能获得的地租之间的差距；Sisson (2024) 则说明，Communities Plus 计划挑选高价值地块，以便国家获得“物有所值”。悉尼市议会说，绅士化“加剧了能负担和不能负担住房的人之间的相对不平等”，并且市场正变得“对中低收入以下的人几乎无法进入”（City of Sydney n.d.）。对悉尼和墨尔本，Atkinson et al. (2011, 10) 发现，绅士化街区的迁出率比其他地方条件相当的家庭高出约 50%，不过他们的数据来自 2000 年代。
items.summary: ¶5.1　课件：绅士化单元。概念：Smith 租金差；Stein 的国家主导（引自讲义）。展开：把价格背景连到“谁获得收益”，并用 City of Sydney 自己的文件和 AHURI 2011 说明代价。限定：AHURI 数据早于更新。

items.en: The unit’s critique of social mixing bears on the remedy. Lees (2008) argues that policy treats gentrification as a route to more mixed and less segregated communities on a poor evidence base, and describes social mixing as a positive packaging of gentrification. Yrjänä (2026) shows in Helsinki how an anti-segregation policy can serve state-led gentrification, with a subsidy gap in which the state pays the difference to de-risk private investment. Waterloo’s documents use the language of mixing, and Homes NSW states that “part of the success of mixed housing communities is that social and private housing are indistinguishable” (Homes NSW 2026). The planning documents also cite Green Square as a precedent for built form (LAHC 2020, §5.1.7), and its town centre has about 3 per cent social and affordable housing (Turner Studio & Turf 2020, App. 6, 463). Whether a mix of 28 per cent social housing, within a market-led development, dilutes the cluster or prepares the area for higher-income residents is the question of the unit. The documents describe the intention and do not yet show the result.
items.zh: 这个单元对社会混合的批评，与药方有关。Lees (2008) 认为，政策把绅士化当作通向更混合、更少隔离的社区的路径，而证据基础薄弱，她把社会混合描述为绅士化的一种正面包装。Yrjänä (2026) 展示了赫尔辛基的反隔离政策如何服务于国家主导的绅士化，其中的补贴差距(subsidy gap)是国家补上差额，以降低私人投资的风险。Waterloo 的文件使用混合的语言，Homes NSW 说，“混合住房社区成功的一部分，在于社会住房与私人住房无法区分”（Homes NSW 2026）。规划文件还把 Green Square 作为建筑形态的先例（LAHC 2020, §5.1.7），而它的镇中心社会与可负担住房约占 3%（Turner Studio & Turf 2020, App. 6, 463）。在一个由市场主导的开发里，28% 的社会住房混合，是稀释了聚集，还是在为更高收入的居民准备这片地区，这是这个单元的问题。文件描述了意图，还没有显示结果。
items.summary: ¶5.2　课件：绅士化单元。概念：Lees 对社会混合的批评；Yrjänä 的国家主导绅士化。展开：用文献的论点读 Waterloo 的“混合”；Green Square 先例出现在这里（支线）。限定：这是文献的论点用来读案例，不是发现。

items.en: Protections have grown on paper since 2015. They include the right to return, six months’ notice, staged relocation, more social homes and a share for Aboriginal households (NSW Government 2023, 2024; Homes NSW 2026). The reported gaps are also clear. The plan replaces 749 social dwellings with 847, an increase of 98 (NSW Department of Planning and Environment 2022, PDF pp. 8, 37; difference calculated), the minister could not confirm how much of the 20 per cent affordable housing would be permanent (Bowring 2026), and activists said that at least ten people were still living on the site while the minister said that the remaining people were not tenants (Bowring 2026). No figures are published on how many tenants return or how soon. For the gentrification unit the question is therefore not whether the new buildings will exist but who will live in them and near them in ten years’ time. The documents promise return and do not yet show it.
items.zh: 自 2015 年以来，纸面上的保护增加了。包括回迁权、六个月通知、分阶段搬迁、更多社会住房，以及给原住民家庭的份额（NSW Government 2023, 2024；Homes NSW 2026）。被报道的缺口同样清楚。该计划用 847 套社会住房取代 749 套，只增加 98 套（NSW Department of Planning and Environment 2022, PDF pp. 8, 37；差值由计算得出），部长不能确认 20% 的可负担住房里有多少是永久的（Bowring 2026），活动人士说至少还有十个人住在场地上，而部长说剩下的人不是租户（Bowring 2026）。没有公布回迁租户的人数或时间。对绅士化单元来说，问题因此不在于新房会不会建成，而在于十年后谁住在里面、谁住在附近。文件承诺了回迁，还没有显示回迁。
items.summary: ¶5.3　课件：绅士化单元（置换：直接与间接）。展开：纸面上的保护多于 2015 年；记录到的缺口；回迁没有数据。限定：新闻里的说法要写成“据报道”；增加 98 套是计算差；间接置换在这两个片区没有找到研究。

items.en: 6. Conclusion and discussion
items.zh: 6. 结论与讨论

items.en: The renewal changes the first step of the chain by diluting the social housing on the site. Whether it breaks the circle depends on three things that the documents leave open: where the displaced tenants live, how many return, and what the market around the estate does. On the evidence assembled here, the renewal places some tenants in other social housing nearby and promises the return of the rest, in a market where gentrification has widened the gap between households in private housing and in public housing estates (City of Sydney n.d.). The reputational gap that Zanardo et al. (2024) and Sisson (2024) describe, a devalued present set against an idealised future, offers one explanation for why the remedy is accepted. The planning documents point to precincts such as Green Square for the future they offer (LAHC 2020, §5.1.7). That reading is mine, and it is the least tested part of the argument.
items.zh: 更新通过稀释场地上的社会住房，改变了链条的第一步。它能不能打破这个循环，取决于文件没有回答的三件事：被搬迁的租户住在哪里，有多少人回迁，以及这片住宅区周围的市场会怎样。根据这里汇集的证据，更新把一部分租户安置到附近的其他社会住房，并承诺其余的人会回迁，而所处的市场里，绅士化已经拉大了住在私人住房的家庭和住在公共住宅区的家庭之间的差距（City of Sydney n.d.）。Zanardo et al. (2024) 和 Sisson (2024) 所描述的声誉差距，即被贬低的现在与被理想化的未来相对照，为这个药方为什么被接受提供了一种解释。规划文件把 Green Square 这样的片区当作它们所提供的未来的参照（LAHC 2020, §5.1.7）。这种读法是我的，也是整个论证里检验得最少的部分。
items.summary: ¶6.1　课件：收回隔离与绅士化两个单元。展开：回答论文问题——“取决于去向、回迁和周围的市场”，不是“已经打破”或“只是搬走”；声誉差距与先例作为支线放在这里。

items.en: The argument has limits. It rests on documents and published studies rather than interviews, so residents’ experience is represented through other people’s research and single news reports. Relocation destinations are named but not counted. The price series turned in 2026, so the claim concerns two decades of rise and not the present. The five-step chain is a way of reading the case, and the documents do not use it. No official document sets out the land-value funding model, and the rents of Waterloo and Zetland did not rise between the 2016 and 2021 censuses.
items.zh: 这个论证有边界。它依据的是文件和已发表的研究，而不是访谈，所以居民的经验是通过别人的研究和个别新闻报道来呈现的。搬迁的去向有名称，但没有人数。价格序列在 2026 年转向，所以这里的主张涉及的是二十年的上涨，不是现在。五步链是读这个案例的一种方式，文件本身并不使用它。没有官方文件说明土地价值的资金模式，而 Waterloo 与 Zetland 的租金在 2016 与 2021 年两次普查之间并没有上涨。
items.summary: ¶6.2　课件：边界说明（对应课程要求的 discussion）。把限定一次说清：无访谈、去向无人数、价格 2026 年转向、五步链是读法、土地价值模型无官方说明、普查租金反例。

items.en: Several things follow for planning, and each can be checked against the documents. The return promise should be defined and reported: how many tenants return, when, and to the same place or only the same area. The share of social housing should be published alongside the number of social homes, because the number rises while the share falls. The destinations of relocated tenants should be reported. The permanence of the affordable homes should be confirmed. Where the existing buildings can be renovated, retention should be considered (Zanardo et al. 2024). These suggestions do not require that the policy acts in bad faith. They ask that the cost of the remedy to the people it is meant to help be counted.
items.zh: 对规划有几点启示，每一点都可以对照文件来检验。回迁的承诺应当被界定并报告：多少租户回迁，什么时候，回到同一个地方还是只回到同一个区域。社会住房的占比应当与社会住房的数量一起公布，因为数量在上升而占比在下降。被搬迁租户的去向应当报告。可负担住房是否永久应当得到确认。在现有建筑可以翻新的地方，应当考虑保留（Zanardo et al. 2024）。这些建议并不需要以政策出于恶意为前提。它们只要求把这个药方对它想要帮助的人所造成的代价计算进去。
items.summary: ¶6.3　课件：讨论部分，连回四个单元：回迁（绅士化单元）、占比与去向（隔离单元）、保留与翻新（住房单元）。每一条都可以对照文件检验。
